"(1) Adjust excavator posture: stick vertical, bucket retracted, plumb line passes through axes A and B. (2) The pivot connecting the bucket and stick is A; the four-bar linkage pivots are A, B, C, and D in clockwise order. (3) Attach the receiver above axis A so that the height to axis A is approximately equal to the distance from axis A to the bucket tip. (4) Install the hook/calibration rod and plumb line; the intersection of the plumb line and the hook/calibration rod is N; NT is perpendicular to LR, and the foot T lies on the line connecting bucket tips L and R. (5) If the left and right tip lengths differ, use the left tip length as the reference; the foot T lies on the horizontal line through tip L."

Select a clearly marked, stable ground point as point O, then complete the following actions in order. After posing, slightly raise the boom, gently rock the excavator once, then quickly align the left bucket tip with point O and tap the button below to collect.
Action 1: Extend the stick outward to the limit, keep the bucket vertical with the left tip under axis A, and collect point O with the left bucket tip.
Action 2: Retract the stick inward to the limit, curl the bucket fully outward, and collect point O with the left bucket tip.
Action 3: Adjust the stick angle so the pointer below is in the green zone, curl the bucket fully outward, and collect point O with the left bucket tip.
Action 4: Adjust the stick angle so the pointer below is in the green zone, curl the bucket inward about 30°, and collect point O with the left bucket tip.
Action 5: Adjust the stick angle so the pointer below is in the green zone, curl the bucket inward about another 30°, and collect point O with the left bucket tip.
